gpt.rationale: The mostly subdued neutral/sadness choices fit an introverted girl, but repeated fear on gentle hesitation and several neutral lines that should show strain or timid resolve flatten key emotional turns.

claude.rationale: Sprites consistently reflect an introverted personality—fear and neutral dominate, with restrained emotional displays even during high-stress moments; happiness appears only when helping others or resolving conflict, never self-centered. Minor slip: 'happiness' after being late feels slightly too overt for someone who 'hates calling attention to herself,' though the internal warmth justifies it.
